title: The date range defaults to this month and allows one year at most
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 3 S3-R1 Reports Story 1 S1-R2 TPX-23)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Open the Date filter.
  3. Pick Custom range.
  4. Type a From date more than a year before the To date (for example 01/01/2025 to 10/31/2026).
  5. Type a From and To date that both are yesterday.
  6. Type a From and To date that both are today.
  7. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The first chip reads "Date: This month" and is blue.

Step 2:

  • The list reads This month, Last month, This quarter, Last 90 days, Year to date and Custom range.

Step 3:

  • From and To boxes show with the help text "One year at most."

Step 4:

  • Under the boxes it reads "Choose a date range of one year or less." in red.
  • The report keeps its last valid range.

Step 5:

  • With yesterday as the range, the report reads "There are no results for selected date range": work order 1 was invoiced today.
  • The Date chip shows yesterday's date.

Step 6:

  • With today only, the range is applied.

Step 7:

  • Tier A's row reads Parts Invoiced $121.50 ($135.00 × 0.90).
